name: ZWrld Music
about: ZWrld Music is an independent record label founded by the artist ZWrld in Colorado. We release country, hip-hop and faith-inspired music from artists with something real to say, and we help them get it heard.

what_we_do.headline: Everything you need to get heard

items.title: Beats & production
items.text: Help building your sound, from the beat to the finished track.

items.title: Mixing
items.text: Clean, radio-ready mixes so your song hits like it should.

items.title: Cover art
items.text: Artwork that looks right on every platform.

items.title: Lyric & music videos
items.text: Visuals for YouTube, TikTok and Instagram.

items.title: Radio & press
items.text: We pitch your music to radio stations, blogs and local press.

items.title: Social promo
items.text: Content and promo plans to grow your fans online.

looking_for.headline: Independent artists
looking_for.note: Artists from anywhere welcome. Based in Colorado.

steps.title: Submit a link
steps.text: Send us a link to your music with the form below.

steps.title: We listen
steps.text: We listen to every submission within 2 weeks.

steps.title: We talk
steps.text: If it's a fit, we set up a call to get to know you.

steps.title: Sign a simple agreement
steps.text: A short artist agreement, written in plain language.

deal.headline: Simple and fair

highlight.text: The label gets 5% of your earnings. The other 95% is yours.

terms: You keep full ownership of your music. It's yours, always.
You and the label both hold a license to your songs.
If you leave the label, all licensing rights go back to you, at no cost.

submit_intro: Got a song you believe in? Send us a link. We listen to every submission and reach out if it's a fit for the label.
submit_steps: Send a link to your track (SoundCloud, YouTube, Google Drive or Dropbox). No file uploads.
Only send music you wrote and recorded, or have the rights to.
We listen to everything. If it's a fit, we'll email you about next steps.
